summary.zh: 为课程大纲补充近期同行评议论文与阅读材料
summary.en: Adds recent peer-reviewed papers to a course syllabus

description.zh: 读取课程大纲或教学提纲，按主题分组查找近期同行评议论文，最后输出一份含摘要和讨论题的 Word 文档。适合备课时补充阅读材料，或为学生整理延伸阅读。需要联网检索文献。
description.en: Takes a course syllabus or outline, groups the topics, finds recent peer-reviewed papers and writes a Word document with summaries and discussion questions. Useful for building reading lists. Needs internet access.
